data.desc: Genpact (NYSE: G) is the Agentic Operations company, where frontier AI meets context-rich process intelligence. For decades, we have run mission-critical operations for the world's leading enterprises across finance, risk, supply chain, banking, insurance, and procurement. Today, with Agentic Operations, agents run the work, and our experts own the outcomes, so clients grow faster, operate leaner, and convert more to cash. Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Facebook.
